completion_checks.description: Every computed signal label follows the declared structure-order mapping and the ordered assignment key is recorded.
Every experimental peak and every computed signal was paired exactly once; unmatched entries are reported, never dropped.
Every required nucleus has a declared TMS reference and the solvent/method/basis/scaling conditions are recorded in provenance.
The model-asset version is content-addressed and the DP5 assets are present before any model-based claim is made.

limitations.text: This capability never launches GIAO or conformer sampling; it compares an existing shielding table with a supplied experimental peak list.
A missing required reference, partial coverage or a missing model asset downgrades the report to inconclusive/unavailable; it is never filled with a gas-phase or placeholder value.
The comparison reports assignment and calibration facts; it does not claim a quantitative experimental prediction.

preconditions.description: A structure-order atom mapping (symbols, unique labels and index base) is declared for the shielding table.
The experimental peak list is recorded as a digested source artifact; peaks are never invented or silently dropped.
The method/basis, solvent, TMS reference and scaling mode in force are declared for every required nucleus.
The packaged DP5/FCHL model assets are resolvable and content-addressed; a missing asset is reported as unavailable, never ignored.

described.reason: registered in the read-only capability registry

installed.reason: pure analysis reads existing artifacts; no installed executable is required

notes: Provenance records the molecule/atom mapping and its ordered assignment key, the digested experimental-spectrum source, the solvent/TMS reference/scaling conditions, the model-asset version and the model-asset availability.

completion_checks.description: The task completed and produced a finite shielding table keyed in the declared atom-index base.

limitations.text: The task stops at the GIAO shielding table. TMS conversion, atom mapping, assignment, calibration and model-asset evidence belong to nmr.compare.

preconditions.description: A resolvable molecular structure is supplied.
Charge and multiplicity are consistent with the electron count.
A real QC executable is resolvable by the existing software seam at execution time.
The atom-index base of the shielding table is declared so the table keys keep their identity between the task and the comparison.

completion_checks.description: The supplied weight form, declared tolerance, supplied sum and the resulting normalized weights are recorded in provenance.
The resulting normalized weights sum to 1 within the declared tolerance.
Every declared component contributes a weight and a Gibbs value; a missing component is reported as incomplete.
The ensemble total Gibbs energy is finite and derived from the rank-1 component and its normalized weight.

limitations.text: The component weights are supplied by the caller and recorded; they are not re-derived from the Gibbs values or replaced by Boltzmann weights.
A component without a weight or Gibbs value makes the ensemble incomplete; no partial total is presented as the ensemble total.
The result applies to the declared temperature only; a different temperature requires a new evaluation and provenance record.

preconditions.description: At least one ensemble component with a unique component_id is declared.
Every component carries a finite positive weight; the supplied form is raw or explicitly normalized, never silently converted.
A positive finite ensemble temperature is declared.
The standard state in force is declared; an unspecified state is reported instead of being fabricated.

notes: Provenance records the temperature, the supplied and normalized standard state, the supplied weight form and tolerance, the supplied/normalized weights, the component ids (including missing ones) and the resulting rank-1 total Gibbs value.
